⇒ 360 = (P × 8 × 1.5)/100

⇒ A = 3000 × 108/100 × 108/100 × 108/100

⇒ A = Rs. 3779.136

A, B, and C complete the work in 81 days, A and B in 97.2 days, B and C in 162 days

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

questions.question: Let α, β be the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0; γ, δ be the roots of px² + qx + r = 0 ;& D₁ , D₂ the respective discriminants of these equations. If α, β, γ, δ are in A.P. Then find the value of D₁ : D₂
questions.solution:
**Given:**

α, β, γ, δ are in A.P.

**Formula:**

Equation: ax² + bx + c = 0

⇒ Sum of roots = -b/1; Product of roots = c/a; Discriminant = b² - 4ac

A, B, C are in A.P.

⇒ B - A = C - B ⇒ 2B = A + C

**Calculation:**

Sum of roots, α + β = -b/a and γ + δ = -q/p

Product of roots, αβ = c/a and γδ = r/p

Discriminants, D₁ = b² - 4ac and D₂ = q² - 4pr

We know, (x - y)² = (x + y)² - 4xy

(α - β)² = (b/a)² - 4(c/a) = (b² - 4ac)/a²

⇒ α - β = √D₁/a ----(i)

Similarly, γ - δ = √D₂/p ----(ii)

∵ α, β, γ, and δ are in A.P.

⇒ α - β = γ - δ

⇒ √D₁/a = √D₂/p

⇒ √(D₁/D₂) = a/p

∴ D₁/D₂ = a²/p²

questions.question: In triangle ABC, AD ⊥ BC and AO is the bisector of ∠BAC. If ∠ABC = 65° and ∠ACB = 23frac{{1^circ }}{2}, then ∠DAO is ____ (in degrees)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ABC = 65° and ∠ACB = 23frac{{1^circ }}{2}

**Formula:**

Angle bisector bisects the angle in two equal parts.

Sum of all interior angles of a triangle = 180°

∠DAO = ½ × (∠ABC - ∠ACB)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df34ebf442e45966b352cae00742d22bee834ec7ea9b29ff4b871c82ac89729.png]

∠DAO = ½ × (65° - 23.5°) = 20.75°

If AO is bisector of ∠ABC

⇒ ∠BAO = ∠OAC = ∠BAC/2

In ΔABC

∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ 65° + 47/2 ° + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 183/2 °

∠BAO = ∠OAC = 183/(2 × 2) = 183°/4

In ΔDAC

∠ADC + ∠DAC + ∠ACD = 180°

⇒ 90° + ∠DAC + 47°/2 = 180°

⇒ ∠DAC = 133°/2

As we know,

∠DAO = ∠DAC - ∠OAC

⇒ ∠DAO = 133°/2 - 183°/4

⇒ ∠DAO = 83°/4

∴ ∠DAO = 20frac{{3^circ }}{4}

questions.question: In a class there were 18 boys and some girls. In a test the mean score obtained by the boys was 12 while that obtained by the girls was 14. If the overall average was 13.1, what was the total number of students in the class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of boys = 18

Average score of the whole class = 13.1

**Formula:**

Average = Total score/Number of students

**Calculation:**

Let the number of girls be x

Average score obtained by 18 boys = 12

⇒ Sum of score obtained by 18 boys = 18 × 12 = 216

Average score obtained by x girls = 14

⇒ Sum of score obtained by x girls = 14x

Total students in the class = x + 18

Average score of whole class = 13.1

⇒ Sum of score of whole class = (x + 18) × 13.1

216 + 14x = (x + 18) 13.1 ⇒ 216 + 14x = 13.1x + 235.8

⇒ x = 19.8/0.9 ⇒ x = 22

 

Total number of girls in the class is 22.

∴ Total number of students in the class = 18 + 22 = 40.

⇒ Remaining distance = x - 2x/5 = 3x/5

1/3rd part of remaining distance covered by bus then

Distance covered by the bus = 3x/5 × 1/3 = x/5

Now final remaining distance

**∴ Required fraction = 2x/5 × 1/x = 2/5**

questions.question: 20 men can finish a certain work in 10 days, where as it takes 12 women to finish it in 10 days. If 15 men and 6 women undertake to complete the work, how many days will they take to complete it?
